title: Flow-through entities — Ann and Leo
instructions: Answer the questions for two unrelated owners of flow-through entities in 2025.

exhibits.title: Ann — Jade Inc. (S corporation, never a C corporation)
exhibits.content: Ann owns 60%. Her stock basis at January 1 was **$20,000**, and she has a **$15,000** direct loan to Jade. Jade's 2025 results: ordinary loss $(70,000); long-term capital gain $5,000; tax-exempt interest $2,000; nondeductible expenses $1,000. No distributions.

exhibits.title: Leo — Harbor Partners
exhibits.content: Leo sells his 25% interest for **$90,000** cash. His outside basis, including his **$20,000** share of partnership liabilities, is **$50,000**. His share of the partnership's unrealized receivables and inventory appreciation (§751) is **$8,000**.

rows.label: Deductible share of the ordinary loss
rows.explanation: Stock basis 23,600 + debt basis 15,000 = **38,600** of her 42,000 share.
